title: Barcelona target a record eighth straight win as Getafe visit Camp Nou
summary: La Liga leaders Barcelona host Getafe at Camp Nou on Saturday in matchday eight, chasing an eighth straight league win that would equal their best-ever start to a top-flight season. Hansi Flick's side have won all seven league games, scoring 31 goals and conceding seven, and lead second-placed Atletico Madrid by five points. Forward Raphinha is out with a thigh problem and Frenkie de Jong and Andreas Christensen also miss out; Getafe sit 11th with eight points and only four league goals this season.
